description_en: Bottles, containers, bags and packaging. The resin code tells you what it is.
description_fil: Bote, lalagyan, supot at pakete. Sinasabi ng resin code kung anong plastik ito.

description_en: Clear drink bottles. Widely bought by junk shops when clean.
description_fil: Malinaw na bote ng inumin. Binibili ng junk shop kapag malinis.

description_en: Stiff, opaque bottles like shampoo and detergent. Recyclable when clean.
description_fil: Matigas at malabong bote tulad ng shampoo at sabon. Nare-recycle kapag malinis.

description_en: Pipes, hoses and some blister packs. Rarely recycled.
description_fil: Tubo, hose at ilang blister pack. Bihirang ma-recycle.

description_en: Soft bags and squeeze bottles. Accepted by some programmes when clean and dry.
description_fil: Malambot na supot at bote. Tinatanggap ng ilang programa kapag malinis at tuyo.

description_en: Food tubs, caps and microwavable boxes. Recyclable when clean.
description_fil: Lalagyan ng pagkain, takip at microwavable. Nare-recycle kapag malinis.

description_en: Styrofoam and hard clear cups. Usually residual.
description_fil: Styro at matigas na malinaw na baso. Kadalasang residual.

description_en: Mixed or other resins. Usually residual unless a programme accepts them.
description_fil: Halo o ibang resin. Kadalasang residual maliban kung may programa.

description_en: Clean, dry paper and cardboard are recyclable. Wet, waxed or food-soiled paper is not.
description_fil: Nare-recycle ang malinis at tuyong papel at karton. Hindi ang basa, may wax o may pagkain.

name_fil: Papel na may coating o wax
Papel na may mantsa ng pagkain

description_en: Cans, foil and scrap. Metals keep their value and junk shops buy most of them.
description_fil: Lata, foil at scrap. May halaga ang metal at binibili ng junk shop.

description_en: Bottles and jars are recyclable. Window glass, mirrors and broken glass need care.
description_fil: Nare-recycle ang bote at garapon. Mag-ingat sa salamin ng bintana, salamin at basag.

description_en: Plates, mugs, tiles and pots. Ceramics don't melt with glass, so they go in residual.
description_fil: Pinggan, tasa, tisa at paso. Hindi natutunaw kasama ng bote ang seramika, kaya residual.

description_en: Clothes, linens, shoes and bags. Reuse and donation come first.
description_fil: Damit, kumot, sapatos at bag. Unahin ang paggamit ulit at pag-donate.

description_en: Anything with a plug, battery or circuit board. E-waste goes to registered collectors.
description_fil: Anumang may saksakan, baterya o circuit board. Sa rehistradong kolektor ang e-waste.

description_en: All batteries are special waste. Never put them in a bin loose.
description_fil: Special waste ang lahat ng baterya. Huwag ilagay nang maluwag sa basurahan.

description_en: Bulbs and tubes. Fluorescent lamps contain mercury and need special handling.
description_fil: Bombilya at tubo. May mercury ang fluorescent at kailangan ng espesyal na paghawak.

description_en: Food scraps and garden waste. Compost them or use the green bin.
description_fil: Tirang pagkain at dahon. I-compost o ilagay sa berdeng basurahan.

description_en: Wood, bamboo and cork. Untreated pieces can be reused or composted.
description_fil: Kahoy, kawayan at cork. Puwedeng gamitin ulit o i-compost ang hindi pininturahan.

description_en: Rubber, foam and tires. Hard to recycle, so reuse comes first.
description_fil: Goma, foam at gulong. Mahirap i-recycle, kaya unahin ang paggamit ulit.

description_en: Items made of layers that can't be separated, like cartons and pouches.
description_fil: Gamit na gawa sa patong-patong na hindi mapaghiwalay, tulad ng karton at pouch.

description_en: Medicine, sharps and sanitary items. Sharps and medicine need special handling.
description_fil: Gamot, karayom at pangkalinisan. Kailangan ng espesyal na paghawak ang karayom at gamot.

description_en: Paints, chemicals, pesticides and oils. Keep them in their containers for hazardous collection.
description_fil: Pintura, kemikal, pesticide at langis. Iwan sa lalagyan para sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

description_en: Furniture, mattresses, appliances and debris too big for household bins.
description_fil: Muwebles, kutson, appliance at debris na masyadong malaki para sa basurahan.
